originalTitle: Mcap of five of top-10 most valued firms erodes by Rs 1 lakh cr; TCS takes biggest hit
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: Last week, the value of five of India's top 10 most valuable companies decreased by a huge amount, Rs 1 lakh crore. This means that investors lost a lot of money in these companies. Tata Consultancy Services was the worst affected, with its value dropping the most. On the other hand, some other companies actually gained value, which is a positive sign. Despite all the ups and downs, Reliance Industries remains the most valuable Indian company.

originalTitle: 9 Sensex stocks with up to 41% upside potential. Are these in your portfolio?
simplifiedContent: Some experts who watch the stock market think that 9 specific stocks on the Sensex (a list of important Indian companies) might do very well over the next year. They believe these stocks could increase in value by 20% to 41%. HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, Reliance Industries, and NTPC are some of the companies on this list. This matters because if you own these stocks, your investments could potentially grow significantly in the next 12 months. It might be worth considering whether these stocks are part of your investment portfolio.

originalTitle: 9 penny stocks surge up to 325% in 2026 so far; 3 turn multibaggers. Did you own any?
simplifiedContent: Some very cheap stocks, called "penny stocks", have increased in value by up to 325% this year. This means that if you owned one of these stocks at the beginning of the year, it could be worth more than three times as much now. Three of these stocks have done exceptionally well, becoming "multibaggers", which is a term used to describe stocks that have increased in value many times over. This is significant because it shows that some investors have made a lot of money from these stocks. The surge in value of these penny stocks may be of interest to individual investors who are looking for potential investment opportunities.

originalTitle: Small-cap stock under  ₹50 to be in focus on Monday after receipt of NHAI project
simplifiedContent: A small company called Hazoor Multi Projects, with a stock price under ₹50, might get attention on Monday. This is because it recently got a project from NHAI, which could be good news for the company. The company's stock price actually went down 3.29% on Friday to ₹20.85, and it has been decreasing over the past week and month. This decrease might be temporary, and the new project could potentially help the stock price go up. The attention on Monday will likely be to see how the news of the NHAI project affects the stock price.

originalTitle: Indian stock market: How are Sensex and Nifty 50 likely to perform next week amid US-Iran war uncertainty?
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a mixed week, with the two main indexes, Sensex and Nifty 50, going down in value. The Sensex fell by 0.62% and the Nifty 50 fell by 0.83%. At the same time, some smaller stocks, called MidCap, actually went up in value by 0.50%, while others, called SmallCap, went down by 0.66%. This means that the market is a bit unpredictable right now. The change in the market's value is important because it can affect the money that people have invested in the stock market.

originalTitle: Stocks under  ₹100: Sumeet Bagadia recommends three shares to buy on Monday - 17 August 2026
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a bad day on Friday, ending the week on a low note. An expert named Sumeet Bagadia is sharing his thoughts on what might happen in the market next. He has picked three stocks that cost less than ₹100 and thinks they are good to buy right now. These stocks might be a good opportunity for investors, but it's always important to do your own research before making any decisions. Sumeet Bagadia's recommendations could be helpful for those looking to invest in affordable stocks.
